text: The purpose of this report is to establish and appoint directors to the Lawrence Ingram Keele BIA Board of Management and make necessary changes to Schedule A of the Municipal Code, Chapter 19.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Established a Board of Management for the Lawrence Ingram Keele Business Improvement Area consisting of ten (10) members, including one (1) Councillor (Ward 5, York South-Weston) and make the necessary amendments to Schedule A of Municipal Code Chapter 19. 2. In accordance with the City's Public Appointments Policy, appointed the following nominees to the Lawrence Ingram Keele Business Improvement Area (BIA) Board of Management set out below at the pleasure of the Community Council, and for a term expiring at the end of the term of Council or as soon thereafter as successors are appointed: Cardoso, Lino Economou, Vlasis Gagliano, John Iori, Attilio Mann, Robbert Naimer, Mark Omran, Walid Scavuzzo, Rosie Shulman, Ken
